lines: Longer classes now open as you level up, by your own level from the backend.
At level one you have three classes open. Every other card says the level that opens it.
At level seven the level-five tier is open: thirty minute Tempo Paceline. Ten and twenty stay locked.
At level eighteen only one class is left: the sixty minute ride with surges, at level twenty.
A class your level opened goes straight to Class Start, on any device.
On a phone the shelves stack in one column. From a tablet up, the cards sit side by side.
What the tests prove: only four tiers are allowed, and each opens at its level.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
